name: [2x LUCK!] Takjil Tower
desc:
Climb the tower, grab free takjil, collect as many as you can, and become a crazy rich takjil business owner! 😆

✨Use code: MINIUPDATE

In Takjil Tower, you will:
🧗 Climb the tower to get takjil
🍢 Collect 46 unique takjil with different rarities
⚡ Upgrade & buy gear to boost your farming speed
💸 Build your takjil business and become the richest takjil business owner on the server!
